QuestInfo.name: Cassandra's Lost Letter
QuestInfo.0: The ever-confident #b#p9010010##k is stomping her feet. Go find out what happened to her.
QuestInfo.1: #b#p9010010##k is furious. She thinks #b#p9000021##k took one of her cherished love letters when he came by a while ago.\nThe letter means so much to her. She hasn't even opened it yet!\nYou calmed Cassandra down by promising that you would retrieve her letter. Go talk to #b#p9000021##k to find out where the letter might be.
QuestInfo.2: You've calmed Cassandra down by visiting Gaga, who she suspects of stealing a love letter from her youth.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: Can proceed to Gaga's Alibi quest

0.0: Ugh! Gaga! I will never forgive you!\r\n#L0##bO-okay now. Calm down. I'm not Gaga. What made you so angry?#l\n#k
0.1: Calm down? Calm down?! Gaga stole my letter! I can't forgive him. How dare he steal my stuff?\r\n#L0##bPlease, relax. What kind of letter? Is it that important to you?#l\n#k
0.2: It was a love letter I received from someone I liked when I was little... It means so much to me I haven't even opened it yet.\r\n#L0##b(Why's she so shy all of a sudden?) Why do you think Gaga took it?#l\n#k
0.3: He didn't take it. He stole it! He's the only one it could be. He came by a few days ago and wandered around my room. In the end, he left without even finishing his tea. He was sweating like he didn't know what to do and then he left in a hurry like he was running away. I'm sure he's the one who stole my letter.\r\n#L0##bOkay, you should relax. I'll bring back your letter. (If Cassandra finds Gaga like this, he's dead meat...)#l\n#k
0.4: Really? Okay. I am little tired, after all... #b#h0##k, would you please bring back my letter?

yes.0: And don't forget to tell him that he better watch out. I will find him!

no.0: What? You don't want to do it after all this? #b#h0##k! Did Gaga send you to spy on me?

1.0:
Good day, #b#h0##k.
What beautiful weather! I guess spring is here. Perfect day for a picnic, wouldn't you agree? 
#L0##bA picnic would be nice... Why did you take Cassandra's Letter?! She's furious!#l
#k
1.1: C-Cassandra's letter? I-I don't know what you're talking about...#b(He begins to sweat, and avoids making eye contact with you.)\r\n#L0##bReally? You didn't take Cassandra's Letter?#l\n#k
1.2: L-letter? Ha. Ha. Ha. Never heard of it.\n#b(His laughter is awkward and suspicious...)

npc.0: Get my letter back from Gaga! And tell him he'd better be careful when he wanders around town. I will find him!
